data.name: Althee
data.gender_notes: Althee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Althee is derived from αλθεια (althaea), meaning 'healing' or 'curing'. The name has roots in the Greek goddess of healing, Aletheia, who was believed to bring truth and dispel illusion. In the Christian context, Althee can symbolize spiritual healing and God's grace in times of need. The name Althee carries the meaning “God's healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Althee usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Althee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Althee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
